title: Photography Release Sign-In Log
subtitle: Capture image or audio, capture setting, name use, and publication channel; confirm duration and withdrawal.
description: Photography Release records image or audio, capture setting, name use, publication channel, duration, and withdrawal. Photography Release evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this photography release attendance and custody reconciliation when staff must document image or audio and capture setting. Reconcile name use, publication channel, duration, and withdrawal before the photography release handoff. Use the production brief, capture list, subject match, permitted-use matrix, channel inventory, editing and attribution instruction, publication record, and withdrawal log. Ask the assigned photography release reviewer to confirm image or audio against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Photography Release details
sections.guidance: Itemize image, video, audio, name and quotation use; bound capture setting, publication channel, audience, editing, duration, storage, and withdrawal. Record the photography release decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

sections.title: Photography Release roster verification review
sections.guidance: Track each person's release record, signer verification, scope, expiration, withdrawal, and exception owner.

blocks.label: Photography Release roster boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not treat attendance as permission. Route every missing, expired, limited, declined, or withdrawn release to its named owner before capture or publication.

sections.title: Photography Release exception reconciliation
sections.guidance: Reconcile valid, limited, declined, expired, and missing release records before use.

blocks.guidance: Do not close an unreconciled entry without a named owner.
